ResumeData.title: ResumeData
ResumeData.description: Represents the structured data collected for generating a resume. This document stores the user's input and preferences for a single resume project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ResumeData entity. Matches the Firestore document ID.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this resume. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ResumeData)

jobDescription.description: The full job description the user is targeting, used by the AI for tailoring.

target_job_title.description: The specific job title the user is targeting.

resume_intent.description: The user's primary goal for this resume.

resume_style.description: The selected visual template style for the resume.

language.description: The language for the generated resume content.

createdAt.description: Server-side timestamp indicating when the resume was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server-side timestamp indicating when the resume was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the application. This document stores essential user information separate from authentication data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. Must match the Firebase Auth UID and the document ID.

photoURL.description: URL for the user's avatar image.

createdAt.description: Server-side timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server-side timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The document ID must match the Firebase Auth UID. Path-based ownership ensures only the user can access their profile data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user (matches Firebase Auth UID).

definition.description: Stores resume data for a specific user. Path-based ownership guarantees only the user can access their resume data. Stored in a subcollection under the user's document.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

params.name: resumeDataId
params.description: The unique identifier for the resume data.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for scalability and security. User data is strictly segregated by nesting it within a `/users/{userId}` path. This enables powerful and simple security rules based on `request.auth.uid`. Storing `resumeData` in a subcollection allows for efficient querying of a user's resumes without loading all resume data at once. This one-to-many relationship (user to resumes) is a standard and recommended Firestore pattern.
